title: One coefficient level for a chosen closed affine chart
statement: For one positive finite coefficient stage, a closed immersion i:Y→P with separated finite-type quasi-compact structure maps satisfies the exact closed pushforward, bounded-below dualizing, compact-support composition, and counit-normalization clauses packaged by CoefClosedChartAt.

source.place: Paragraphs 2--3, one fixed coefficient level after the affine chart is chosen

proof.text: Apply the ordinary-etale boundary adjunction restriction, transfer exactness of closed direct image to module sheaves, identify identity-open compact support with termwise direct image, prove the lower bound for the closed right adjoint, and use bounded-below compact-support composition plus uniqueness of right adjoints to obtain the counit-normalized comparison. This is the one-stage component of the two-stage coefficient argument.

proof_origin.place: Split the two-level coefficient package into its one-level component
